instruction.text: Read the letter and select the word that hints at the Gunpowder Plot.

hint.text: Remember that the plotters wanted to blow up the building.

atoms.a: They shall receive a terrible blow this parliament.

atoms.b: This is part of a ((++letter number)) that was sent to Lord Monteagle to warn him not to be in Parliament that day.
Monteagle was a member of Parliament, but also a secret ((++Catholic chocaholic)) and friend of the plotters. No one knows who exactly ((++wrote danced)) the letter.
Monteagle was told to burn it after reading it. Instead, he passed it on to the ((++king queen)) a few days before the 5th of November.

instruction.text: What did King James I do next?

feedback.finish: When the guards searched the cellar, they found Guy Fawkes hidden among the barrels of gunpowder. They arrested him, and he told them his name was John Johnson.

atoms.a: Guy Fawkes sent a letter to the King warning him about the Gunpowder Plot.
King James I ordered a search of Parliament.
Guy Fawkes lied about his name to the guards.
